title: C2 Milestone 16
completion_message: ¡EL PINÁCULO ABSOLUTO! Has superado el Milestone 16 y, con ello, las 80 lecciones del Nivel C2. Has conquistado la gramática, el vocabulario y la sintaxis más compleja y refinada del inglés corporativo mundial. Ya no eres solo un estudiante; eres un Maestro del Inglés. ¡Brindemos por tu extraordinario éxito!

parts.visual:
El examen final. La cumbre de la montaña. 

1. Advanced Legal English 2: 
- Subpoena & Perjury. 
- Affidavit & NDA. 
- Indemnify & Force Majeure. 
- Intellectual Property & Severance package. 

2. Conditional Inversion (Gramática élite): 
- SHOULD YOU need help... (If you need). 
- WERE I the CEO... (If I were). 
- HAD I KNOWN the truth... (If I had known). 
- HAD WE NOT intervened... (If we had not).
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 16, The Absolute Finale. You have reached the summit of the mountain. First, we will evaluate Advanced Legal English. Terms like Subpoena, Perjury, Affidavit, Indemnify, Force Majeure, Intellectual Property, and Severance package. Second, Elite Grammar: Conditional Inversion. Remember to drop the 'If'. Use 'SHOULD YOU need help', 'WERE I the CEO', 'HAD I KNOWN the truth', and 'HAD WE NOT intervened'. Make sure you know these structures perfectly.

parts.visual:
3. High-Level Negotiation: 
- Brinkmanship & Stonewalling. 
- Leverage & Ultimatum. 
- Lowball & Concession. 
- Bluff & Deadlock. 

4. Corporate Crisis Management: 
- Damage control & PR disaster. 
- Scapegoat & Fall guy. 
- Sweep under the rug & Backlash. 
- Boycott & Cover-up. 

¡Es hora de demostrar que perteneces a la élite mundial!
parts.audio: Third, High-Level Negotiation. The psychological warfare terms: Brinkmanship, Stonewalling, Leverage, Ultimatum, Lowball, Concession, Bluff, and Deadlock. Finally, Corporate Crisis Management. How to survive the worst days. Damage control, a PR disaster, using a scapegoat or a fall guy, sweeping things under the rug, facing a public backlash, a boycott, and avoiding a cover-up. It is time to prove that you belong to the global elite. Good luck on the final exam!

stages.title: The Grand Finale Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio absoluto. Cierra el nivel C2 con honores.

questions.question: Normal: If you had warned me, I would have prepared. -> Inversión: ____ warned me, I would have prepared.
The company was accused of copying the competitor's patent, resulting in a lawsuit for Intellectual ____ infringement.
Normal: If she were to accept the offer, we would be thrilled. -> Inversión: ____ to accept the offer, we would be thrilled.
During the negotiation, they refused to answer our emails or share the data. They were clearly ____ us.
After the scandal broke, the CEO hired an aggressive PR firm to do damage ____.
Normal: If you don't receive the email, please call us. -> Inversión negativa: ____ receive the email, please call us.
We need to get the VP to sign an ____, swearing under oath that he didn't see the document.
We are the only company that sells this rare metal. We have all the ____ in this negotiation.
Normal: If the CEO hadn't lied, the company would have survived. -> Inversión: ____ lied, the company would have survived.
They fired the innocent junior developer to protect the senior management. He was used as a ____.
Lying to the judge while under oath is a felony known as ____.
Pushing a negotiation to the absolute breaking point to force the other side to surrender is ____.
If you try to hide the scandal instead of fixing it, you are sweeping it under the ____.
The boss issued a final ____: accept the terms by 5:00 PM or the deal is permanently cancelled.
Normal: If I were a lawyer, I could help you. -> Inversión: ____ a lawyer, I could help you.
When the company fired him without cause, they gave him a generous ____ package of $2 million.
To reach an agreement, both sides must give something up. We have to make ____.
The product was dangerously defective, and the public ____ against the company was massive.
You promised to fix the servers, but you didn't. You are in ____ of contract.
They offered us an insultingly low amount for the house. They tried to ____ us.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: El último esfuerzo. Escribe la palabra élite correspondiente.

questions.question: ____ I the CEO... (Si yo fuera el CEO con W)
____ you need anything... (Si necesitas con S)
____ I known... (Si hubiera sabido con H)
Guilty of ____. (Perjurio con P)
Sign an ____. (Acuerdo de confidencialidad con N)
We have the ____. (Ventaja/Poder en negociación con L)
An act of ____. (Política al borde del abismo con B)
Damage ____. (Control de daños con C)
Used as a ____. (Chivo expiatorio con S)
A massive PR ____. (Desastre de relaciones públicas con D)
